data.use_of_proceeds: The Company intends to use the net proceeds from this offering to repay $150 million of outstanding 2.875% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2031 and $20 million of outstanding variable rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2033, plus accrued interest, and for general corporate purposes.

tranches.pricing_quote: A floating rate per annum equal to the Benchmark rate (which is expected to be Three-Month Term SOFR) plus 239 basis points
